note: What a server sends to place a camp on the map and say how it is drawn. Its identifier is wider than a byte, so it travels behind the escape.

fields.name: x
fields.note: Where the camp sits, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: z
fields.note: Where it sits, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: icon
fields.note: Names the mark a client draws. What a name resolves to is the game's rather than the protocol's, so this specification records the field and not the meaning of any value.

fields.name: revealEvent
fields.note: What makes the unit known to a side that cannot see it. It is 74 for every camp observed but one, which carries 43.

fields.name: side
fields.note: Which side the camp belongs to, where it belongs to one.

fields.name: timerKind
fields.note: Which clock the client shows for it. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: expires
fields.note: When the camp is next due, in seconds. Observed as zero.
